messages:
jordan: Drafting a Tiered Auth Fallthrough proposal for routing when project keys fail (quota, revoked, missing). Goal: predictable billing attribution + minimal customer surprise. My initial idea: prefer project key -> service account -> org key, but add route annotations for billing-sensitive and admin endpoints to change behavior. WDYT?

maya: baseline sounds right. Please add telemetry hooks so we can tell exactly when a fallback happens and why. Suggested fields: auth.effective_key_type, auth.fallback_reason, auth.fallback_path (list), auth.key_hash. Metrics: auth.fallback.count, auth.fallback.latency.p50/p95, auth.fallback.by_reason. Keep payloads small. :mag:

ethan: UX ask: console should show a compact badge in request logs like "Used ORG KEY (fallback: quota)" with hover copy and a link to the auth-fallback dashboard. No raw key ids in UI — only hashed references and RBAC-protected debug links.

maya: here's a tiny policy sketch (for router) to land in proto form:
```
fallback_policy:
  - when: QUOTA_EXCEEDED
    try: [SERVICE_ACCOUNT, ORG_KEY]
    metric: auth.fallback.quota
  - when: KEY_REVOKED
    try: [SERVICE_ACCOUNT]
    metric: auth.fallback.revoked
  - when: PROJECT_NOT_FOUND
    try: [ORG_KEY]
    metric: auth.fallback.missing_project

route_annotations:
  billing_sensitive: true|false
  prefer_sa_for_admin: true|false
```

jordan: two edge constraints: 1) billing_sensitive routes must never use ORG_KEY unless tenant explicitly opts-in; 2) admin routes should always prefer SA even if a project key exists. We'll encode as route_annotations and enforced at policy evaluation time.

ethan: rollout plan: add a feature flag tiered_auth_v1, enable in staging (5%), capture full traces + hashed key ids for sampling. Expand to 25% non-billing tenants after 48h if no regressions, then 100%. Include emergency kill switch.

ops: need console copy and the dashboard link skeleton to wire alerts. Also need migration notes for customers relying on org_key billing.

jordan: draft badge copy: "Used ORG KEY  fallback (quota)". Hover: "This request used an org-level key because project quota was exceeded. View details" -> /dashboards/auth-fallback?tenant=<tid>&trace=<trace_hash>. We will not expose key ids; use key hash. Confirm redaction policy.

maya: redaction policy proposal: metrics never contain raw ids. Store key_hash in metrics and UI. Full key ids only in ephemeral debug logs (7d retention) accessible with SRE/Debug RBAC. Dashboards for org-admins can show effective_key_type and anonymized key labels.

ethan: SRE, is 7d ephemeral log retention ok for troubleshooting? @sre-bot

sre-bot: canary flag tiered_auth_v1 created. Staging canary live at 7689991280 (5% traffic). Ephemeral debug logs enabled for canary only, retention 7d, access gated by audit-logged RBAC. :white_check_mark:

ops: we also want an alert: auth.fallback.rate_for_billing_routes > 1% triggers P2 to ops oncall. Ops will own the runbook.

jordan: next tasks I will own: 1) add fallback_policy proto + unit tests, 2) implement metrics hooks (auth.* fields), 3) console badge + hover + link, 4) canary playbook and kill switch. Will open PRs and mark reviewers.

maya: please include a checklist in the PR description: dashboards, alert, sampling logs, RBAC gate, UX copy, tests for route annotations. I'll review.

ethan: file+paths suggested: pkg/auth/router/fallback_policy_v1.proto, pkg/auth/router/fallback_eval.go, web/console/src/components/AuthFallbackBadge.tsx, infra/flags/tiered_auth_v1.yaml

jordan: thanks. I'll post PR links and the canary playbook here when ready.

sre-bot: staging canary observed 12 fallback events in first 30m (metric auth.fallback.count). Sampling logs captured for 3 traces.

ops: copying dashboard ticket: https://internal.redwood/dashboards/boards/456 for wiring and alert hooks.

jordan: closing loop: PR opened at https://git.internal/redwood/p/fallback-policy (WIP). Will add UX mocks and playbook this afternoon. Thanks everyone.

maya: thanks, moving to review.

ethan: +1

ops: added alert runbook stub in ticket.
